lines.zh: 我在世界的底下游，头顶全是石头。
lines.en: I swim beneath the world, stone above my head.

lines.zh: 两米多的身子，转身要绕半圈。
lines.en: At two metres, I need half a circle to turn.

lines.zh: 胡须先探出去，身体才跟上来。
lines.en: My whiskers reach ahead; the body follows after.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有水，我却照样在游。
lines.en: There is no water in the void, yet I swim anyway.

lines.zh: 我贴着世界的地基滑过去。
lines.en: I slide along the foundations of the world.

lines.zh: 铁傀儡的渣子还挂在我牙上。
lines.en: Bits of iron golem still hang on my teeth.

lines.zh: 我游得很慢，因为我不必快。
lines.en: I swim slowly, because I do not need speed.

lines.zh: 越黑的地方，我看得越清楚。
lines.en: The darker it gets, the clearer I see.

lines.zh: 活了这么多年，我走最短的路。
lines.en: After all these years, I take the shortest road.

lines.zh: 我一路吞掉挡路的碎石。
lines.en: I swallow the rubble in my way as I go.

lines.zh: 水流被我推开，很久才合上。
lines.en: The water parts around me and closes long after.

lines.zh: 我绕过一根石柱，它比我细。
lines.en: I pass a stone pillar thinner than I am.

lines.zh: 底下没有光，我不用躲。
lines.en: There is no light below; I have nothing to hide from.

lines.zh: 我经过的地方，只剩空水。
lines.en: Where I have passed, only empty water remains.

lines.zh: 五只铁傀儡的事，我快忘光了。
lines.en: I have almost forgotten about those five iron golems.

lines.zh: 我一张嘴，前面的水就少一截。
lines.en: I open my mouth and the water ahead drops a notch.

lines.zh: 地基裂了条缝，我挤过去。
lines.en: A seam opened in the foundation; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫过石壁，扫下一层灰。
lines.en: My tail drags the stone wall and knocks down a layer of dust.

lines.zh: 我停在地基下，像一块沉了的岩。
lines.en: I rest under the foundation like sunken rock.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等黑暗里的东西自己进来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, waiting for the dark to swim in.

lines.zh: 饥饿在我肚子里滚，像磨石。
lines.en: Hunger turns in my belly like a millstone.

lines.zh: 我数铁傀儡，五个，一口。
lines.en: I count iron golems: five, in one bite.

lines.zh: 传说越传越大，我懒得更正。
lines.en: The legend grows; I cannot be bothered to correct it.

lines.zh: 我的胡须在水里慢慢摆。
lines.en: My barbels sway slowly in the water.

lines.zh: 上面的世界在走路，我听得见。
lines.en: The world above is walking; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 五年前咬过的东西，我还记得味道。
lines.en: I still remember the taste of what I bit five years ago.

lines.zh: 没人钓到我，所以他们编故事。
lines.en: No one has landed me, so they invent stories.

lines.zh: 我的鳃开合很慢，一次要很久。
lines.en: My gills open and close slowly, one breath lasting long.

lines.zh: 洞顶的石屑落下来，我抬眼看。
lines.en: Grit falls from the roof; I look up.

lines.zh: 老了以后，我连饿都懒得喊。
lines.en: Growing old, I cannot be bothered to complain of hunger.

lines.zh: 这下面安静得能听见石头长。
lines.en: Down here it is quiet enough to hear stone grow.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼，世界就只剩味道。
lines.en: I close my eyes and the world becomes only taste.

lines.zh: 你在上面探头，我看见一只眼睛。
lines.en: You lean over the edge; I see one eye.

lines.zh: 你的线垂下来，晃得像条虫。
lines.en: Your line drops down, wriggling like a worm.

lines.zh: 我认得钓鱼的人，他们的手会抖。
lines.en: I know anglers; their hands shake.

lines.zh: 你离虚空这么近，胆子不小。
lines.en: Standing this close to the void, you are bold.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，水压替我压着声音。
lines.en: I look up; the pressure keeps my voice down.

lines.zh: 你在数我的长度，我在数你的骨头。
lines.en: You count my length; I count your bones.

lines.zh: 那双眼睛里有光，我不喜欢。
lines.en: There is light in those eyes; I dislike it.

lines.zh: 我把头探出水面，你看清了没有？
lines.en: I lift my head from the water; did you see clearly?

lines.zh: 你想钓我，先站稳。
lines.en: If you mean to fish me, plant your feet first.

lines.zh: 我沉回去了，只留一圈水纹。
lines.en: I sink back, leaving one ring of water.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我的皮自己会合上。
lines.en: My hide closes over a wound like this by itself.

lines.zh: 二十五点血，够你砍一会。
lines.en: Twenty-five health; you can swing for a while.

lines.zh: 这点痛比不上我肚子里的空。
lines.en: This pain is nothing beside the hollow in my belly.

lines.zh: 刀陷进我的脂肪，拔不出来。
lines.en: The blade sinks into my fat and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我从来不掉血，我掉的是鳞。
lines.en: I do not lose blood; I lose scales.

lines.zh: 你砍的地方，一百年前也挨过。
lines.en: You struck a spot that was struck a century ago.

lines.zh: 这点痛比虚空里的冷好受。
lines.en: This pain is kinder than the cold of the void.

lines.zh: 我一动，水就把伤口压住。
lines.en: I move and the water presses the wound shut.

lines.zh: 你再砍，我就记住你的味道。
lines.en: Keep cutting and I will remember your taste.

lines.zh: 我流的是暗色的血，看不见。
lines.en: My blood is dark and cannot be seen.

lines.zh: 你挂的饵太小，不够我塞牙。
lines.en: Your bait is too small to pick my teeth.

lines.zh: 那块肉的味道，我从地底就闻到了。
lines.en: I smelled that meat from under the world.

lines.zh: 我张嘴试了试，钩子先进来。
lines.en: I open my mouth to test it; the hook comes first.

lines.zh: 你晃线的手太急了。
lines.en: Your hand jigs the line too eagerly.

lines.zh: 铁的味道让我想起傀儡。
lines.en: The taste of iron reminds me of golems.

lines.zh: 我绕着饵游了一圈，没咬。
lines.en: I circle the bait once and do not bite.

lines.zh: 这么香的东西，通常有诈。
lines.en: Something this fragrant usually means a trick.

lines.zh: 再等一会，我会咬的。
lines.en: Wait a little longer; I will bite.

lines.zh: 我的肚子比我的谨慎更响。
lines.en: My belly is louder than my caution.

lines.zh: 你把饵往上提，我就跟上去。
lines.en: You lift the bait and I follow it up.

lines.zh: 我侧身蹭过你，你退了两步。
lines.en: I brush past you sideways and you step back twice.

lines.zh: 我这身皮撞上来，跟墙一样。
lines.en: This hide of mine hits like a wall.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我撞的是岸。
lines.en: You stand on the bank; it is the bank I strike.

lines.zh: 我的尾鳍扫过你的腿。
lines.en: My tail fin sweeps across your legs.

lines.zh: 别把手伸进水里，我会当成食。
lines.en: Keep your hand out of the water, or I take it for food.

lines.zh: 这一下我只用了半分力。
lines.en: I used only half my strength there.

lines.zh: 你被我顶得后退，石头都松了。
lines.en: I shove you back and the stones loosen.

lines.zh: 我太宽，窄处过不去，就撞。
lines.en: Too wide for narrow gaps, I simply ram through.

lines.zh: 你听见响声了吗？那是我的牙。
lines.en: Hear that rattle? That is my teeth.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只撞一次。
lines.en: I do not chase; I strike once.

lines.zh: 世上像我这样的鱼，只剩几条。
lines.en: Only a few fish like me are left in the world.

lines.zh: 我们在地基下相遇，谁也没张嘴。
lines.en: We meet beneath the foundation and neither opens its mouth.

lines.zh: 它的胡须比我的长一寸。
lines.en: Its barbels are an inch longer than mine.

lines.zh: 我们并排游，水被挤成两条沟。
lines.en: We swim abreast, pressing the water into two furrows.

lines.zh: 卵沉进虚空，我从不回头看。
lines.en: The eggs sink into the void; I never look back.

lines.zh: 这么大的鱼，幼崽只有指甲长。
lines.en: Fish this large start out no longer than a nail.

lines.zh: 我们绕了三圈，算是定了。
lines.en: We circle three times; that settles it.

lines.zh: 它老了，我也是，正好。
lines.en: It is old and so am I; that suits us.

lines.zh: 这可能是最后一次，我游得很慢。
lines.en: This may be the last time; I swim slowly.

lines.zh: 各自游开，水纹很快平了。
lines.en: We swim apart and the ripples flatten quickly.

lines.zh: 你想用桶装我？桶先裂了。
lines.en: You would bucket me? The bucket cracks first.

lines.zh: 我大半截身子还在外面。
lines.en: Most of my body is still hanging out.

lines.zh: 这桶对我来说是一顶帽子。
lines.en: This bucket is a hat to me.

lines.zh: 你提着桶走路，桶底在响。
lines.en: You walk with the bucket; its bottom creaks.

lines.zh: 我蜷起来，骨头咯咯地叫。
lines.en: I curl up and my bones click.

lines.zh: 我在桶里翻身，水全洒了。
lines.en: I roll over in the bucket and the water is gone.

lines.zh: 你比钓我的人有胆量。
lines.en: You have more nerve than the ones who fished me.

lines.zh: 这铁箱子里，我闻到了铁傀儡。
lines.en: In this tin box I smell iron golem.

lines.zh: 放我回虚空，我还你一条船。
lines.en: Put me back in the void and I will spare you a boat.

lines.zh: 桶太小，我的牙一直磕着边。
lines.en: The bucket is small; my teeth keep knocking its rim.

lines.zh: 水里的味道变了，我抬起头。
lines.en: The water's taste changes; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 上面那团影子，比傀儡大。
lines.en: That shadow up there is bigger than a golem.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它，就不换了。
lines.en: Once I fix on it, I do not switch.

lines.zh: 这个不够塞牙，但能动。
lines.en: This one will not fill me, but it moves.

lines.zh: 我听见心跳，一下一下，很清楚。
lines.en: I hear a heartbeat, steady and very clear.

lines.zh: 它是自己下来，不是我上去。
lines.en: It came down to me; I did not go up.

lines.zh: 我选了最慢的那一个。
lines.en: I picked the slowest one.

lines.zh: 钩子上的也算，我不挑。
lines.en: Whatever is on the hook counts too; I am not picky.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在暗里对准了它。
lines.en: My eyes line up on it in the dark.

lines.zh: 目标定了，我就沉下去等。
lines.en: The target is set; I sink and wait.

lines.zh: 我跟着它，隔着一层石头。
lines.en: I follow it through a layer of stone.

lines.zh: 它走一步，我游一步，一样慢。
lines.en: It takes a step, I take a stroke, equally slow.

lines.zh: 我留着力，等它靠近水边。
lines.en: I save my strength until it nears the water.

lines.zh: 这条影子我咬了三天，还没咬到。
lines.en: I have hunted this shadow three days running.

lines.zh: 它回头看了，我不动。
lines.en: It glances back; I do not move.

lines.zh: 黑暗替我挡着，它看不见我。
lines.en: The dark covers me; it cannot see me.

lines.zh: 我的耐心比它的腿长。
lines.en: My patience is longer than its legs.

lines.zh: 我只要它再往前一步。
lines.en: I only need it to take one more step.

lines.zh: 水下的泥被我压出一道沟。
lines.en: The mud beneath me is pressed into a trench.

lines.zh: 它停下来喘气，我也停下来。
lines.en: It stops to breathe, and so do I.

lines.zh: 一口下去，铁傀儡就剩半截。
lines.en: One bite and the iron golem is cut in half.

lines.zh: 我的牙不尖，可它夹得住。
lines.en: My teeth are not sharp, but they clamp.

lines.zh: 你听见的是护甲变形的声音。
lines.en: What you hear is your armour bending.

lines.zh: 牙一合上，它就不再挣了。
lines.en: My jaws close and it stops struggling.

lines.zh: 一口吞五个，传说是真的。
lines.en: Five in one bite: the legend is true.

lines.zh: 我的上颚压下来，水都让开。
lines.en: My upper jaw comes down and the water yields.

lines.zh: 这一口我留了半寸。
lines.en: I held back half an inch on that bite.

lines.zh: 你比傀儡软，也比傀儡吵。
lines.en: You are softer than a golem, and louder.

lines.zh: 咬完我才发现，你太小了。
lines.en: Only after biting do I find you too small.

lines.zh: 我的牙缝里卡了一小块铁。
lines.en: A chip of iron is stuck between my teeth.

lines.zh: 线一紧，我就被拽出了虚空。
lines.en: The line tightens and I am hauled out of the void.

lines.zh: 我在水面出现，整片湖都沉了一下。
lines.en: I break the surface and the whole lake sinks a little.

lines.zh: 这么多年，终于有人把我钓上来。
lines.en: After all these years, someone has finally landed me.

lines.zh: 我从没有自然生成，只被拉上来。
lines.en: I never spawned naturally; I was only hauled up.

lines.zh: 水面破开，我先露的是胡须。
lines.en: The surface breaks; my barbels come out first.

lines.zh: 岸上的人退了半步，这很合理。
lines.en: The people on the bank step back; that is reasonable.

lines.zh: 我落进浅水，尾巴还在虚空里。
lines.en: I land in the shallows, tail still in the void.

lines.zh: 这片水太浅，装不下我。
lines.en: This water is too shallow to hold me.

lines.zh: 我张口呼吸，空气的味道很怪。
lines.en: I gape for breath; the air tastes strange.

lines.zh: 世界比传说里小得多。
lines.en: The world is far smaller than the legend says.

lines.zh: 火烫进皮里，我闻到自己熟了。
lines.en: Fire bites into my hide and I smell myself cooking.

lines.zh: 我从虚空掉下去，落回虚空。
lines.en: I fall from the void and land back in the void.

lines.zh: 水灌满鳃，我第一次觉得水太多。
lines.en: Water floods my gills; for once there is too much.

lines.zh: 爆炸在我侧面开了一个洞。
lines.en: The blast opens a hole in my side.

lines.zh: 一支箭插进我的厚背。
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my thick back.

lines.zh: 魔力钻进鳞下，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Magic burrows under my scales and I shudder.

lines.zh: 饿到极处，我连石头都想咬。
lines.en: Starved this far, I would even bite stone.

lines.zh: 雷穿过水，打在我脊背上。
lines.en: Lightning crosses the water and strikes my spine.

lines.zh: 我本来就住虚空，它拉不走我。
lines.en: I already live in the void; it cannot take me.
